status: Implemented; final full local460/94/ninearm64passes. Current-source hosted package/app acceptance pending. Full modernization and wider MathJax parity remain open.

engines.ordinary: Existing pinned KaTeX0.19.1. Ordinary supported batches remain KaTeX; no MathJax initialization is needed.
engines.compatibility: Pinned MathJax4.1.3 and original TeXfont4.1.3 execute in actor-confined JavaScriptCore. Bundled module export boundary only; all application orchestration is Swift.
engines.licenses: Original Apache2.0 notice in app and resource bundle; carried with the KaTeX MIT notice in portable math styles. Original inline module notices retained by bundling.
engines.runtime: No Node, native DOM/file/network bindings, document scripts, loader/autoload/require or arbitrary HTML TeX package. Original TeX SVG outlines need no runtime font downloads.

behavior.routing: Public KaTeX rendering determines compatibility before any consumer publication. Small ordinary batches replay the existing bounded batch cache. Ordinary batches too large to cache use a second streaming pass; this adds computation while keeping memory bounded. Unsupported batches use one ordered MathJax document, without a TeX source rewrite.
behavior.definitions: Custom newenvironment/renewenvironment with arguments, existing def/newcommand/renewcommand/let semantics and per-document isolation. Native MathJax recompile metadata resolves forward and backward explicit tag/label/eqref references. Automatic numbering stays off, matching the characterized original default.
behavior.source: MathExpression exactUTF8 keys include parser completeness. Incomplete/unclosed math is kept literal and cannot define macros in either engine. Source coordinates remain on the single cmark tree.
behavior.output: Validated inert SVG plus semantic MathML and exact original-TeX annotations. IDs are uniquely scoped per document batch; internal references map across equations, with hidden MathML duplicate IDs removed. Definition-only spans add no space.
behavior.errors: Malformed/unsupported, oversized or unsafe output stays escaped source with the existing preview notice, preserving other equations.
behavior.cache: Shared64entry/2MiB nominal UTF8 source+HTML budget, including whole compatibility batches. Compiled roots are released as streamed outputs are consumed or on cancellation/error.

limits.resources: No active elements, external links/resources, arbitrary CSS functions, external entities or DTDs. All math href targets are local scoped IDs.

local.newCore: Seven new methods: custom environments/ordered redefinition and reset, full-batch cache, forward/back references and unique targets, mixed standard math/fonts/matrices/cancellation/text, errors/recursion/geometry and consumer interruption, byte-exact annotations and invalid-source isolation, output beyond2MiBcache budget, hostile markup rejection.
local.native: Light/dark offline WebKit checks pass with actual equation geometry, internal reference targets, exact annotations, absent page MathJax and disabled page scripts. Definition-only outer math block is exactly zero height in both appearances. One-page PDF preserves heading/end text. All three final PNGs inspected.
local.review: Strict changed Swift formatting, build-script syntax, pinned-resource/reproduction-input/license verification and final source hashes checked.

diagnostics.unclosedBlocks: Initial existing-contract failure exposed MathJax accepting delimiter text inside an unclosed source span. Explicit parser completeness now retains escaped source and prevents state changes.
diagnostics.references: Strict markup boundary initially rejected the library reference class and pointer-events hitbox; only those inert attributes added after pinned-source inspection.
diagnostics.mixedMath: Additional package coverage and mathsize attribute preserve standard supported formulas when a document requires compatibility rendering.
diagnostics.nativeTestCompile: Nested require macros corrected to separate typed values; no production workaround or assertion relaxation.
diagnostics.definitionLayout: A stronger whole-block check fails twice before correction: inner definition span was hidden but its display-math parent retained padding. Hide the outer block too; both appearance cases now report zero height, with unchanged assertions elsewhere.

performance.scope: Two final alternating native Debug probe pairs,32single-formula edits per engine over24ordinaryformulas. Baseline uses705cc00MathRenderer; current uses final source. Initial pilot timings retained separately. Same bundled KaTeX resources. No whole-app or Release performance acceptance.
performance.finding: Ordinary formulas still produce KaTeX. Small observed routing overhead is measured in hundredths of a millisecond; no speedup or broad performance claim. Large uncached ordinary batches require an extra rendering pass, still within existing full-suite streaming contracts.
performance.furtherSourceChange: The final change after timing only hides an empty definition-block CSS parent. Routing/cache code is unchanged; the exact measured sources remain in compact/performance.
